title: A Model For Everyone: How Ronak From Trajectory Is Building Products For Continual Learning
description:
Today’s agents are stuck in what Ronak Malde calls “pseudo continual learning”: intelligent, but updated in offline batches, like a paper road map you can’t reroute mid-trip. Ronak, co-founder of Trajectory, explains why closing that loop is the next learning paradigm, and why training your own model, which used to take a dedicated research team, months of work and hundreds of millions in compute, is now something a company can do in a few clicks with their own data. He details two research bets they are making available to everyone with their product: 1) a variant of GRPO that removes the need for a simulated environment by learning from single real-world rollouts instead of 16 replays of the same task, and 1) a meta-grader that increased data efficiency by 100x. Ronak explains how Harvey trained a model six times cheaper than frontier, improving an open-source baseline by over 4x on Harvey's own legal benchmark. He defines the difference between continual learning and recursive self-improvement and predicts product builders will become gardeners, setting trellises for products that grow themselves.

title: David Silver and Lasse Espeholt of Ineffable Intelligence: A Superlearner for the Age of Experience
description:
David Silver spent two years building AlphaGo on human data. When he removed human data altogether building AlphaGo Zero, the AI surpassed AlphaGo in under two days. He left DeepMind to run that same bet in pursuit of superintelligence. David and Lasse Espeholt, co-founders of Ineffable Intelligence, explain their plan to build a “superlearner”—an agent that starts knowing nothing and discovers science, mathematics, and language for itself by direct experience instead of through a pre-training run. Silver argues that human-language reasoning is a ceiling, not a foundation, that alignment via chain-of-thought monitoring is already reaching its limits, and that the science of how superintelligences coexist should be worked out in simulation before anything touches the real world. Espeholt describes the GPU cluster and the lineage from IMPALA and SEED RL that makes the experiment possible. Silver’s forecast: strong evidence within a year, superintelligence in three.

title: AI Realism Workflow the Pros Use (Eleven v4 + Seedance 2.5)
description:
Keep your AI film characters sounding the same in every scene with Eleven v4 and Seedance 2.5.

Create AI Films → https://elevenlabs.io/creative?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=trend_tutorials&utm_content=create_consistent_character_voices_with_eleven_v4_and_seedance_2_5_ai_workflow

One of the biggest problems in AI filmmaking is characters losing their voice between scenes. In this workflow, we walk through how to pair Eleven v4 voice generation with Seedance 2.5 inside ElevenCreative so your character keeps the same voice, emotion, and delivery across every shot. We start by generating the perfect delivery in Eleven v4 using audio tags to direct the performance, then storyboard the scene in Flows with the voice over in place before generating any video.

From there we cover three ways to use that voice generation as a reference in Seedance 2.5, each one making the result more consistent:

• Method 1 • Use the Eleven v4 generation as an audio reference alongside a character reference and a set reference, then prompt the scene with tagged references
• Method 2 • Convert the MP3 into a plain black MP4 video and use it as a video reference, which tends to extract the delivery more reliably than the audio file
• Method 3 • Add a timestamp transcript from the black video using an LLM node, tag it in your prompt, and offset the timestamps so the action (like a crash landing) lands before the character starts speaking

We also cover choosing a voice from the Great voices for Eleven v4 selection in the voice library, lip syncing the generation to your character in Flows, and generating the scene separately so you can control the background. By the third method you can focus entirely on the prompt and the action while the voice delivery stays consistent every time.

Li has served as a Vice President at Google and Chief Scientist of AI/ML at Google Cloud (2017-2018), board member or advisor in various public or private companies and is currently a Co-founder/CEO of World Labs, an AI company focusing on Spatial Intelligence and generative AI. 

- Jeff Dean: Computer scientist and software engineer. He is best known for his work at Google, which he joined in 1999. He led Google AI from 2018 to 2023 and was Google's chief scientist from 2023 to 2026. Dean co-founded the AI research start-up Discovery Loop in 2026.
